description_en: Suppresses or unsuppresses precheck alert items
description_zh: 屏蔽或取消屏蔽预检查告警项目
kebab_example: aliyun dts skip-pre-check --skip true --dts-job-id c7412z57g8k0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SkipPreCheck

parameters.help_en: The ID of the precheck task. You can call DescribePreCheckStatus to query the ID
parameters.help_zh: 预检查任务ID，可以调用DescribePreCheckStatus查询
parameters.name: job_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to suppress the precheck item. Valid values:

true: Suppress the precheck item.
false: Unsuppress the precheck item
parameters.help_zh:
是否屏蔽该预检查项目，取值：

true：屏蔽。
false：取消屏蔽
parameters.name: skip

parameters.help_en:
The abbreviated names of the precheck items to suppress or unsuppress. Valid values:

["CHECK_SAME_OBJ"]: check for objects with the same name.
["CHECK_SAME_USER"]: check for accounts with different names.
["CHECK_SRC"]: source database version check.
["CHECK_TOPOLOGY"]: topology version check. For the topology versions supported by DTS, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/124115.html.
["CHECK_SERVER_ID"]: source database server_id check.
["CHECK_DEST_TABLE_EMPTY"]: destination database object existence check.
["CHECK_SUPER_AUTH_DEST"]: destination database super account permission check.

Separate multiple item names with commas (,), for example, ["CHECK_SRC","CHECK_SAME_OBJ"]
parameters.help_zh:
需屏蔽或取消屏蔽的预检查项目简称，取值：

["CHECK_SAME_OBJ"]：同名对象存在性检查。
["CHECK_SAME_USER"]：不同名账号存在性检查。
["CHECK_SRC"]：源库版本检查。
["CHECK_TOPOLOGY"]：拓扑版本检查。目前DTS支持的拓扑版本，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/124115.html。
["CHECK_SERVER_ID"]：源库server_id检查。
["CHECK_DEST_TABLE_EMPTY"]：目标库对象存在性检查。
["CHECK_SUPER_AUTH_DEST"]：目标库super账号权限检查。

多个项目名称用英文逗号（,）分隔，例如["CHECK_SRC","CHECK_SAME_OBJ"]
parameters.name: skip_pre_check_items

parameters.help_en:
The full names of the precheck items to suppress or unsuppress. This parameter corresponds to the SkipPreCheckItems parameter. Valid values:

["CHECK_SAME_OBJ_DETAIL"]: check for objects with the same name.
["CHECK_SAME_USER_DETAIL"]: check for accounts with different names.
["CHECK_SRC_DETAIL"]: source database version check.
["CHECK_TOPOLOGY_DETAIL"]: topology version check. For the topology versions supported by DTS, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/124115.html.
["CHECK_SERVER_ID_DETAIL"]: source database server_id check.
["CHECK_DEST_TABLE_EMPTY_DETAIL"]: check whether the destination database tables are empty.
["CHECK_SUPER_AUTH_DEST_DETAIL"]: check the super account permissions of the destination database.

Separate multiple item names with commas (,), for example, ["CHECK_SRC_DETAIL","CHECK_SAME_OBJ_DETAIL"]
parameters.help_zh:
需屏蔽或取消屏蔽的预检查项目名称，对应参数SkipPreCheckItems，取值：

["CHECK_SAME_OBJ_DETAIL"]：同名对象存在性检查。
["CHECK_SAME_USER_DETAIL"]：不同名账号存在性检查。
["CHECK_SRC_DETAIL"]：源库版本检查。
["CHECK_TOPOLOGY_DETAIL"]：拓扑版本检查。目前DTS支持的拓扑版本，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/124115.html。
["CHECK_SERVER_ID_DETAIL"]：源库server_id检查。
["CHECK_DEST_TABLE_EMPTY_DETAIL"]：检查目标库表是否为空。
["CHECK_SUPER_AUTH_DEST_DETAIL"]：检查目标库super账号权限。

多个项目名称用英文逗号（,）分隔，例如["CHECK_SRC_DETAIL","CHECK_SAME_OBJ_DETAIL"]
parameters.name: skip_pre_check_names
